featured_reviews.review_text:
I don’t reside in India and was visiting for just 10 days due to a dental emergency. I honestly can’t believe how well I was accommodated by Dr. Raviraj. Despite the limited time, he ensured that all my treatments - including root canals, cleaning, and polishing were completed professionally and with great care.

What stood out most was his attention to my comfort and ease throughout the process. He also recommended excellent aftercare and products to support my recovery once I returned home. I’m incredibly grateful for the dedication and expertise he showed.

A big thank you to Dr. Raviraj - you’re a star! Highly recommended for anyone seeking top-notch dental care.

featured_reviews.name: vinaykore films
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited SmileWave Dental Clinic for a cap replacement on my front tooth and I was very happy with the experience. From the moment I walked in the doctor and the staff were warm, welcoming and professional.
The dentist took the time to explain the entire procedure, which helped ease any anxiety I had. Dentist was very gentle, precise and extremely skilled with the treatment procedure and the new cap looks incredibly natural and matches perfectly with my other teeth. I really appreciated the attention to detail and the genuine care they showed throughout the process.
The clinic itself is modern, clean and equipped with the latest technology, which made everything smooth and efficient. I left feeling confident with my smile again — something that means a lot to me.
I would highly recommend SmileWave Dental Clinic!
